display.purpose: Stacked uppercase enamel claims on marketing heroes.

headline.purpose: Interior marketing page titles in Archivo Black.

title.purpose: Brand wordmark and app section titles.

body.purpose: Ledes, privacy copy, and chat message text.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro labels for notes, status, and nav.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Transient dialog/menu elevation only — not resting chrome.

motion.name: board-in
motion.purpose: Staggered plate entrance on marketing surfaces.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button fill/color and light lift transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal enamel CTA — Download, Start Voice, Send.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.9rem 1.35rem; font-family: Archivo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #1a1812; background: #58f03a; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7aff5c; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58f03a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.9rem 1.35rem; font-family: Archivo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #1a1812; background: #e8d4a8; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #d4bc8a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58f03a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: App chrome secondary action without fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Archivo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; color: #5a5143; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f5edd8; color: #1a1812; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58f03a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Signal Bar
components.description: One green enamel stripe per marketing plate.
components.css: .ds-signal-bar { width: min(100%, 22rem); height: 0.55rem; background: #58f03a; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Square ink-framed model/status chip with signal ready dot.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Archivo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1a1812; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; background: #e8d4a8; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 0; background: #7a6f5c; } .ds-status-pill.ready .ds-dot { background: #58f03a; }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: Square paper field; focus border shifts to signal.
components.css: .ds-input-composer { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; background: #f5edd8; border: 1px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: #1a1812; font-family: Archivo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; resize: none; } .ds-input-composer::placeholder { color: #7a6f5c; } .ds-input-composer:focus { outline: none; border-color: #58f03a; } .ds-input-composer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58f03a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: Square ink-framed mark beside Archivo Black wordmark.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; color: #1a1812; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; border-radius: 0; background: #d4bc8a; } .ds-brand-name { font-family: "Archivo Black", "Arial Black", Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Stacked Directives
components.description: Hero enamel claims with optional signal underline on the last line.
components.css: .ds-directives { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-directives li { font-family: "Archivo Black", "Arial Black", Impact, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.35rem, 8vw, 4.75rem); line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1a1812; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-directives li + li { margin-top: 0.12em; } .ds-signal-line { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-signal-line::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0.06em; height: 0.18em; background: #58f03a; z-index: -1; }

components.name: Mode Badge
components.description: Square mode chip; fills green signal only when voice is live.
components.css: .ds-mode-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: Archivo, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #5a5143; border: 1.5px solid #1a1812; } .ds-mode-badge.active { background: #58f03a; color: #1a1812; }

narrative.overview:
Marvin reads as Swiss industrial enamel signage: stacked uppercase directives on quiet paper, thick ink rules, and a single yellow signal used like a CRT caution stripe — not a soft AI glow. Clarity is the personality. The marketing site boards the claim (local voice, you in charge); the app operates the same materials with yellow reserved for live voice and status.

Density is sparse and frontal. Surfaces are matte paper fields with a whisper of enamel grain; no orbs, no purple haze, no floating glass. Depth comes from ink borders and tonal paper steps, not shadows on primary chrome.

(Shipped Signal Board supersedes the older cream/sage/Fraunces note still lingering in PRODUCT.md brand history.)
keyCharacteristics: Paper field #e8d4a8 + near-black ink #1a1812 + one signal yellow #58f03a
Archivo Black for directives; Archivo for body and UI chrome
Square enamel edges (border-radius: 0) on primary chrome
Thick ink rules (1.5px–2px) for section cuts and frames
Yellow used sparingly: one bar, primary CTAs, live-voice accents

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow occupies a small fraction of any screen. One bar or one live-voice control cluster is enough; flooding yellow kills the stripe.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Figure and rule are ink on paper (or paper on ink in dark theme). Never swap signal yellow into body text or large backgrounds.

rules.name: The Stacked Directive Rule
rules.body: Hero claims stack as short uppercase enamel lines, not a long sentence headline. Keep lines board-short; do not wrap into paragraph display.

rules.name: The No Soft Serif Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce Fraunces, Georgia, or other editorial display faces into this world.

rules.name: The Flat Enamel Rule
rules.body: Buttons, pills, badges, brand marks, signal bars, and chat bubbles sit flush. Do not add ambient drop shadows to resting chrome.

rules.name: The Square Edge Rule
rules.body: Primary interactive chrome is square. Soft radii belong only to incidental overlay chrome until those surfaces are brought into enamel; do not treat soft cards as the house shape.

dos: Do keep signal yellow rare — bar, primary CTA, or live-voice state.
Do stack short uppercase Archivo Black directives for hero claims.
Do use square edges and 1.5–2px ink rules on primary chrome.
Do set body/lede on muted ink over paper, not black slabs of yellow.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by dropping board-in and hover lift.
donts: Don't build soft AI heroes, purple gradients, glow orbs, or glassmorphism on resting surfaces.
Don't round primary buttons, pills, badges, or the signal bar.
Don't use yellow as a page wash or for long-form text.
Don't revive Fraunces/Sora/sage as the marketing system — Signal Board is the shipped world.
Don't invent kickers/eyebrows above the brand; the brand and directives are the board.
